title: sigelo/0 genesis
description: An identity's genesis document (SPEC §4, §3.1). Its DID is did:sigelo: + multibase(SHA-256(JCS(genesis))); no key outside the §3.1 row. Also the shape of a rotation's next_genesis and of each bundle issuers entry.

recovery.description: The recovery commitment, or null: theft of the identity key is then terminal.

nonce.description: 16 random bytes by default; verifiers do not check the length (SPEC §2).
